scope.method: Opened every current main image asset with view_image. Compared with canonical article titles, descriptions, leads and image-relevant passages, current captions, alt text and credit metadata. Reused existing source/licence provenance.

nonblocking_observations.observation: Historical sunset photograph is dark, but shore and surf remain legible; current caption correctly limits its evidentiary role.
Statue photograph is soft and dark at full source size, but suitable as a restrained portrait with an accurate statue caption.

nonblocking_observations.action: Retain; a workshop/process photograph would be an optional future editorial addition only if independently sourced and licensed.
